text:
Amy: quick follow-up on operator-driven soft-drain token for dedicated GPU pools. idea: let operator mark nodes as "soft-drain" so runtime stops new admissions and warmup credits but finishes inflight. want tradeoff thoughts and rollout plan.

Jason: useful. main risk is warmup-credit abuse if suppressed incorrectly. ensure soft-drain toggles warmup_allowed=false.

Sven: also need per-model drain hook to flush KV caches; otherwise TTL-based force kill could corrupt state.

Neha: observability: expose node.soft_drain.active, node.soft_drain.inflight, node.soft_drain.ttl_left. alert if inflight > threshold near TTL.

Jason: operator->runtime proto sketch: { node_id, token_id, start_ts, ttl_sec, priority_penalty }. runtime: reduce admission score by penalty, stop warmup grants, keep serving inflight, call model drain hooks, emit soft_drain_complete.

Amy: rollout: RFC appendix -> POC operator + runtime honor -> telemetry + runbook -> canary 1 node 30m -> expand. owners: Amy/Sven POC, Jason runbook, Neha telemetry.

Sven: apply tokens incrementally to avoid admission thrash. prefer nodes without preempt-shield labels. dry-run mode helpful.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: issue created https://git.internal/redwood/ops/soft-drain-token

Amy: thanks, will draft PR with minimal API and console UX mock for per-node pill showing TTL + inflight. closing for now.
